description_en: Queries a Skill by name that is visible to the current caller
description_zh: 按名称查询当前调用者可见的 Skill
name: GetSkill

parameters.help_en: The release history version number to query. If omitted, the current Skill main record is returned
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的发布历史版本号。省略时返回当前 Skill 主记录
parameters.name: skill_version

parameters.help_en: The network type of the download URL. Valid values: public and internal. If omitted, no download URL is generated
parameters.help_zh: 下载地址的网络类型。可选值为 public 和 internal。省略时不生成下载地址
parameters.name: network

schema.description_en: The Skill information returned by the GetSkill operation
schema.description_zh: GetSkill 接口返回的 Skill 信息

CanDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller can delete the Skill
CanDelete.description_zh: 当前调用者是否可以删除该 Skill

CanModify.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller can modify the Skill
CanModify.description_zh: 当前调用者是否可以修改该 Skill

CreatedAt.description_en: The creation time of the Skill, in Unix millisecond timestamp
CreatedAt.description_zh: Skill 创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Description.description_en: The description in the current Skill main record
Description.description_zh: 当前 Skill 主记录中的描述
Description.example: 用于执行代码审查和风险提示的 Skill

DownloadUrl.description_en: The bundle download URL. Returned when a network type is specified, an accessible Artifact exists, and pre-signing succeeds
DownloadUrl.description_zh: bundle 下载地址。指定网络、存在可访问的 Artifact 且预签名成功时返回

DownloadUrlNetwork.description_en: The network type used to generate the download URL
DownloadUrlNetwork.description_zh: 实际生成下载地址所使用的网络类型

IconUrl.description_en: The Skill icon URL, sourced from the iconUrl in the metadata. This field may be empty if no icon is configured
IconUrl.description_zh: Skill 图标地址，来源于元数据中的 iconUrl。没有配置图标时可能为空

Metadata.description_en: The Skill metadata, mapped to the metadata field in the backend response
Metadata.description_zh: Skill 元数据，映射到后端响应的 metadata 字段

Official.description_en: Indicates whether the Skill is an official Skill

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Status.description_en: The current Skill status. Common values are DRAFT and PUBLISHED
Status.description_zh: 当前 Skill 状态。常见值为 DRAFT 和 PUBLISHED

UpdatedAt.description_en: The update time of the Skill, in Unix millisecond timestamp
UpdatedAt.description_zh: Skill 更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Visibility.description_en: The visibility of the current Skill. Common values are user and tenant
Visibility.description_zh: 当前 Skill 的可见性。常见值为 user 和 tenant
